title: NFT-DAO
tagline: NFT-DAO where users can vote using NFT instead of ERC-20 token.
description: This project is about NFT-DAO. Mainly there are many DAO in market mostly use ERC-20 token, users must hold their native token to vote for the DAO proposals. Instead of token we will give users NFT the users who hold the NFT they can eligible for the vote in DAO proposals. We have only written smart contracts.
how_its_made:
This   project is made    using Solidity. Smart Contract written in Solidity   with the help of Openzeppelin Library contracts. We have use Hardhat   tool  to  deploy the contract using wallaby testnet on FEVM.
We didn't use any   sponsors technology only RPC of wallaby testnet.
